verdict.rationale: Vanta clearly runs automation in the background: continuous automated tests and evidence collection, a TPRM Agent that discovers and monitors vendors, an AI Agent that flags issues, and automated risk-assessment reminders. Users can also extend this with Custom Tests built on pushed data and with webhooks that fire on events. However, the evidence shows mostly built-in automation the vendor preconfigured, not a user-facing way to define their own autonomous automations or agent tasks. All support comes from first-party marketing and docs. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduling or triggers for agent actions, documented controls over autonomous agent behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
